title: Invoice total is off by a cent for some baskets
body:
Synthetic sample issue.

A basket of three items at 0.10 each with 5% tax charges 0.33. The tax on 0.30 is 0.015, so the total should be 0.32. It looks like each line is rounded on its own before the lines are added up.

The failing test `tests/test_totals.py::test_total_rounds_once_not_per_line` shows it.

title: Discount over 100 percent gives a confusing error
body:
Synthetic sample issue.
